title: Identification of potential mechanisms of ferulic acid in inflammatory bowel disease through integrated network pharmacology and experimental validation.
authors: He, Ziyue; Meng, Fangyu; Yang, Xian; Zeng, Jun
one_liner_zh: 该文通过网络药理学和实验验证研究阿魏酸在炎症性肠病中的抗炎机制，仅涉及FA与STAT3蛋白的简单分子对接，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Inflammatory bowel diseases (IBD) are chronic inflammatory disorders of the digestive tract, and ferulic acid (FA), a phenolic compound with anti-inflammatory activity, has emerged as a promising therapeutic candidate. In this study, we combined bioinformatics analyses with in vitro molecular experiments to elucidate the anti-inflammatory effects and potential mechanisms of FA in IBD. An IBD-like cellular model was established by stimulating human intestinal epithelial NCM460 cells with lipopolysaccharide (LPS), and the effects of FA on inflammatory cytokines were assessed using ELISA, RT-qPCR, and Western blot. Bioinformatics screening identified STAT3 as a potential target associated with FA-mediated anti-inflammatory activity in IBD. We found that FA markedly downregulated inflammatory cytokines, including IL-6 and TNF-alpha, and further experimental evidence indicated that FA significantly inhibited the phosphorylation of STAT3, JAK1, and JAK2. Docking simulations showed that FA could embed in the STAT3 binding pocket with a moderate docking score. Collectively, these findings support FA as a low-toxicity candidate modulator of JAK/STAT signaling with potential therapeutic relevance to IBD.
abstract_zh: 炎症性肠病（IBD）是消化道的慢性炎症性疾病，而阿魏酸（FA）作为一种具有抗炎活性的酚类化合物，已成为有前景的治疗候选药物。在本研究中，我们结合生物信息学分析与体外分子实验，阐明了FA在IBD中的抗炎作用及其潜在机制。通过用脂多糖（LPS）刺激人肠道上皮NCM460细胞建立了IBD样细胞模型，并使用ELISA、RT-qPCR和Western blot评估了FA对炎症细胞因子的影响。生物信息学筛选确定STAT3为与FA介导的IBD抗炎活性相关的潜在靶点。我们发现FA显著下调了包括IL-6和TNF-α在内的炎症细胞因子，进一步的实验证据表明FA显著抑制了STAT3、JAK1和JAK2的磷酸化。对接模拟显示，FA能以中等对接分数嵌入STAT3结合口袋。总体而言，这些发现支持FA作为JAK/STAT信号的低毒性候选调节剂，对IBD具有潜在治疗相关性。
